items.title: Dawoud Sabu Adeyola interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 30, 2025
items.q: Nat, Yusef Lateef, Joe Zawinul, one of my very favorite mentors, Sam Jones on bass

ctx.x: Oh, that’s a great album. They had just made that album, for Capitol Records, when they came to Kleinhans, and it was a double bill because George Shearing was on the first half, and then Cannonball’s quintet was on the second, and with Cannonball, his brother

Nat, Yusef Lateef, Joe Zawinul, one of my very favorite mentors, Sam Jones on bass, and Louis Hayes on drums. So I had a good, you know, it was like my coming out party. That’s the first jazz concert I ever went to.
Were you playing the bass at the time?
